function.name: generate_video_deepfake
function.description: Generates a deepfake video given a source video and a target face.

source_video_path.description: The local path of the source video.

target_face_image_path.description: The local path of the target face image.

output_video_path.description: The local path where the output video will be saved.

function.name: generate_audio_deepfake
function.description: Generates a deepfake audio given a source audio and a target voice.

source_audio_path.description: The local path of the source audio.

target_voice_sample_path.description: The local path of the target voice sample.

output_audio_path.description: The local path where the output audio will be saved.

function.name: manipulate_video_deepfake
function.description: Manipulates an existing deepfake video, such as changing the target face.

input_video_path.description: The local path of the input deepfake video.

new_target_face_image_path.description: The local path of the new target face image.

output_video_path.description: The local path where the output video will be saved.

function.name: manipulate_audio_deepfake
function.description: Manipulates an existing deepfake audio, such as changing the target voice.

input_audio_path.description: The local path of the input deepfake audio.

new_target_voice_sample_path.description: The local path of the new target voice sample.

output_audio_path.description: The local path where the output audio will be saved.

function.name: verify_deepfake
function.description: Verifies if a given video or audio file is a deepfake.

media_path.description: The local path of the media (video/audio) to be verified.
